title: Strobe tuner (demo)
description: Strobe tuner for guitar and 5-string bass. Foot switch mutes, PARA sets the reference pitch, the volume knob sets the level.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: Ambient looper, glitch delay with grains and pitch shifting, and reverb. 8 presets. Source: github.com/OpenGP5/Dreamcatcher.

title: NAM Loader
description: Plays NAM A2 captures at 48 kHz, each with its own cab IR if you like. 12 slots, filled from the Tones page.
